title: Synergistic suppression of cell growth: Phenmiazine derivatives targeting p53 and MDM2 unveiled through hybrid computational method.
authors: M, Srinivasan; Y, Ismail; N, Irfan; S, Mohammed Zaidh
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接和MD模拟设计靶向p53/MDM2蛋白的小分子抑制剂，虽涉及蛋白-配体互作，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法部分可借鉴。
abstract: Lung cancer is the leading cause of mortality in both men and women due to genetic and epigenetic modifications. Our study focuses on fabricating phenmiazine ring leads by a functional group-based drug design to inhibit p53 -7A1W and MDM2-7AU9 proteins responsible for cancer cell growth. One hundred molecules are designed and allowed to bind inside the active site of 7A1W and 7AU9 protein using a glide dock platform and subjected to find MMGBSA. The stability and interaction were confirmed by MD simulation analysis at 100 ns and DFTB chemical stability study. The result gave the best binding energy of -8.16 kcal/mol for aminobenzoic acid substituted molecule and the MD simulation head map illustrates that majorly 9 amino acids form hydrophobic and h-bond interactions. DFTB analysis reveals the energy gaps of 0.0508 signifying stability and lower chemical reactivity of the Phenmiazine ring derivatives. These findings conclude that the Phenmiazine ring derivative will be a better lead molecule to eradicate lung cancer.
abstract_zh: 肺癌是男性和女性死亡的主要原因，这归因于遗传和表观遗传修饰。我们的研究聚焦于通过基于官能团的药物设计来制备吩噻嗪环先导化合物，以抑制负责癌细胞生长的p53-7A1W和MDM2-7AU9蛋白。设计了一百个分子，并使用glide dock平台将其对接至7A1W和7AU9蛋白的活性位点内，随后进行MMGBSA计算。通过100 ns的MD模拟分析和DFTB化学稳定性研究确认了稳定性和相互作用。结果显示，氨基苯甲酸取代分子具有最佳结合能-8.16 kcal/mol，MD模拟热图表明主要9个氨基酸形成疏水性和氢键相互作用。DFTB分析揭示能隙为0.0508，表明吩噻嗪环衍生物具有稳定性和较低的化学反应活性。这些发现得出结论，吩噻嗪环衍生物将成为根除肺癌的更好先导分子。
